hook: Your photo of Pluto shows a giant heart.
title: Your Photo of Pluto Shows a Giant Heart
description:
In 2015, NASA's New Horizons flew past Pluto and photographed a heart-shaped region called Tombaugh Regio. Its left side is a plain of nitrogen ice. Part of the series If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #Pluto #Space
comment_prompt: Love it or not? One word

scenes.headline: PLUTO'S GIANT HEART

scenes.narration: NASA's New Horizons flew past in 2015.
scenes.headline: NEW HORIZONS, 2015

scenes.narration: It photographed a bright, heart-shaped region.

scenes.narration: That region is named Tombaugh Regio.

scenes.narration: Nitrogen is also most of the air you breathe.
scenes.headline: AIR, FROZEN SOLID

scenes.narration: On Pluto, it is frozen solid.
scenes.headline: FROZEN SOLID

scenes.narration: A heart drawn in ice, billions of kilometres away.
scenes.headline: A HEART IN ICE
